verdict: Tower rent inched up 1%, but site development work fell by more than a third, so total revenue slipped about 3% and net income dipped to $231M.

kpis.label: AFFO per share
kpis.note: -3% YoY; AFFO is the cash-profit measure tower REITs watch

segments.name: Site leasing
segments.note: Rent paid by wireless carriers for space on SBA's cell towers — the core, recurring business.

segments.name: Site development
segments.note: Services helping carriers build and upgrade sites — a much smaller, project-based business that shrank sharply.

opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Staff and office costs of running the tower company, including share-based pay.

opex.name: Depreciation, accretion & amortization
opex.note: Non-cash wear-and-tear charge on towers and related assets.

opex.name: Asset impairment & decommission costs
opex.note: Write-downs and costs of taking towers out of service.

opex.name: Acquisition & new business costs
opex.note: Costs of deals and new business initiatives.

flow.otherDetail: Other income of -$114M (sum of rounded components) is interest income of $8M, non-cash interest income of $16M and other income of $15M, minus interest expense of $127M, deferred financing fee amortization of $6M and a $20M loss on extinguishment of debt. Equity of -$1M is profit attributable to noncontrolling interests, leaving $231M for SBA shareholders out of $232M total net income.

takeaways.title: Tower rent is steady, services slumped
takeaways.text: Site leasing revenue rose 1% to $665M, but site development revenue fell 36% to $49M, pulling total revenue down to $714M.

takeaways.title: Cash profit per share held up
takeaways.text: AFFO (adjusted funds from operations, a REIT cash-profit measure) was $3.19 per share, and SBA bought back $300M of its own stock in the quarter.

takeaways.title: Profit dipped slightly
takeaways.text: Net income attributable to SBA was $231M, down from $237M a year ago, after a $20M loss on paying off debt early and $13M of impairment and decommission costs.

oneTimers: $20M loss on extinguishment of debt in the quarter.
$13M of asset impairment and decommission costs.
SBA sold all of its towers in Chile and Ecuador and agreed to sell its towers in Peru, exiting South America outside Brazil.
footerNote: REIT adaptation: cost of revenue is the direct cost of running the towers and development projects ($134M site leasing + $38M site development); depreciation and G&A sit in operating expenses, and interest expense sits in other income, following the site's other tower-REIT pages. SBA reports in thousands; figures are rounded to whole $M and other income is the sum of its rounded components, so the statement balances exactly.
